policy.baseline_note: Steven 2026-11-22: about NT$225,000 gap to the 2.5% target; monthly cap raised to NT$80,000 so one 5-share order fits after the US$350 debit, baseline NT$53,333 keeps cap = 1.5 x baseline as for 009826.
policy.funding: Cathay TWD sub-brokerage only. The TWD debit (shares x reference price x spot selling rate + US$3 fee at the same rate) must pass the D-152 all-bank TWD post-buy floors; USD deposits are not used for this leg.
policy.fx_halving: Same as 009826: a month whose verified USD/TWD mid ever exceeded fx_halving_threshold halves that month's baseline and cap; unknown month FX assumes halved.
policy.gates_retained: D-188/D-205 high-point gate, D-215 USD FX preference, radar/quote/depth/dedup hard gates, 009826+VT pair 4.5% and global-equity group cap stay unchanged.
policy.min_order_note: Steven 2026-11-22: Cathay sub-brokerage charges US$3 per trade, so a ceiling below 5 whole shares is 0 shares (BELOW_MIN_ORDER_SHARES), never a 1- to 4-share order.
policy.role: Global all-cap satellite paired with 009826 (D-139/D-141 fund-family pair); built to its 2.5% target with the same confirmed-fill pace mechanics as 009826, in whole US shares.
policy.scheduled_dca_note: Every confirmed VT buy fill, including the 5th-of-month US$350 D-182 instruction, consumes the monthly TWD amount (amountTwd) and the daily/weekly share counts. Fees are separately funded and excluded, as for VOO.
policy.share_conversion: shares = floor(remaining room TWD / (reference price USD x same-round verified LIVE bank spot selling USD/TWD)); reference price is ask1 when present, else the same-day last price. Missing or non-LIVE spot selling rate gives 0 shares (FX_CONVERSION_UNVERIFIED).

009826.build_clarification: 2026-11-02 clarification of D-143; no cadence number changed.
009826.lot_note: Whichever binds first under D-222: 6 lots per verified Taiwan trading week, 3 lots per day, and the 210,000 TWD monthly cap. Lot count depends on the prevailing price, the TWD cap governs.
